_note: Eligibility rulesets are DATA, not code. Every ruleset ships verified:false and must be confirmed by a compliance officer against the current NCAA/NAIA manual before being trusted. Non-D1 rulesets are placeholders.

rulesets.source_note: Seeded from publicly documented 2024-25 NCAA DI Manual progress-toward-degree standards (Bylaw 14.4): 6 hrs/term, 24 annual (18 fall+spring), 40-60-80 PTD, declare major by 5th semester, GPA 90/95/100% of graduation minimum, 5-year clock. UNVERIFIED — confirm with compliance. NOTE: NCAA approved a June 2026 change moving DI toward five seasons of competition within the five-year clock (phasing in ~fall 2027); seasons_of_competition must be re-verified per effective date.

PLACEHOLDER — D2 does NOT use 40-60-80. It uses annual 24-hour + cumulative-GPA-by-hours thresholds and a 10-semester competition window. Sources conflict on the per-term hour minimum (6 vs 9). Fill from the current D2 manual before use.
PLACEHOLDER — D3 sets institutional standards (no national PTD minimums). Configure per-institution expectations from the current D3 manual / institutional policy before use.
PLACEHOLDER — NAIA progress rules (e.g. 24-hour rule) differ from NCAA. Fill from the current NAIA handbook before use.
